questions.stem: 11-year-old Riya is brought by her mother with a severe headache. The headache began gradually approximately 2 hours earlier, is bifrontal, and is slightly worse on the right side. The girl feels as though "someone is pounding on her head." Approximately 30 minutes before her headache started, she noted changes in her vision and saw "dark spots" while watching TV. The girl had never had headaches until 2 weeks before the presentation when she had a similar episode. Today she had a single episode of emesis and still complains of nausea. She is lying quietly in bed with her eyes closed. Her vitals, physical and neurological examination are normal When asked to sit up, she moves very slowly and carefully. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in the management of this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Administer ibuprofen and counsel the family

options.label: B
options.text: Obtain a computed tomography scan of the head

options.label: D
options.text: Obtain a magnetic resonance image of the brain
